summary.text: Theros Beyond Death follows Elspeth Tirel through the Underworld of Theros, where Heliod strikes her down and Ashiok makes her relive her worst moments.
Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear from a nightmare, turning it into Shadowspear, and with it she defeats Heliod and is granted life by Erebos.
Klothys, furious that souls are escaping the Underworld, sends the Agent of Fate Calix to bring her back, while the gods go to war and bring their champions to fight.
